verdict_a_source_readiness_native.evidence: The post-reload native script calls runPostReloadCaptureBoundary after confirming the owned referrals fixture is ready, titled, and empty. The boundary accepts the exact unsaved-edits dialog only in that state, invokes the existing scrape-recapture-dialog trusted pointer action, then waits for visible Article content containing the referral sentence. Ready/title alone cannot pass. The saved native diagnostic used the older frozen artifact and records one delivered Capture click, no busy state, and no resulting article; it did not record the dialog. No fresh native run of this commit was authorized.
verdict_a_source_readiness_native.first_unverified_boundary: A fresh resource-admitted native run must show the real dialog and completed capture on a new frozen artifact; the existing receipt cannot prove that the confirmation appeared or that this repair resolves the native case.

verdict_b_guard_quality.evidence: The change is limited to the test boundary, its focused tests, and a report. The dialog probe checks exact title and action text; the trusted driver filters to one visible, hit-tested target before dispatching a pointer. A dialog on another page is refused, and only the final owned media-edit path gained confirmation. Capture acceptance still requires visible Article content and the exact referral sentence. The timeout diagnostic remains an allowlist of booleans, and the click/busy probes are disposed in finally. The parent's article-only predicate necessarily times out on a dialog; the candidate's focused dialog test passes, but the claimed historical red result was not independently rerun. No production code, dependency, database, or access path was added.
